node.title: Re: Calculated position incorrect when using regex in text file that also contains binary info (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Just two quick thoughts for now: open the file with the mode '<:raw' (or [doc://binmode] the handle after opening but before reading), and add the /aa regex modifier ([doc://perlre]) to your regexen.

Update: I didn't have enough time earlier to explain why I made these two suggestions, so let me do that now. First, note that on Windows, the :crlf [doc://PerlIO] layer is active by default, translating CRLFs to LFs, which isn't good for binary data. Also, [doc://open]s without explicit layers can be affected by the [doc://open.pm|open] pragma. Second, if you were to open the file with an encoding layer, under Unicode matching rules (see [doc://perlre#/u|/u in perlre]), \d matches any Unicode digits (see [doc://perlrecharclass#Digits|"Digits" in perlrecharclass]).

Update 2: Typo fix
